display_long_description:
# BECOME A SUSHI CHEF IN MULTIVERSE! 

Step into the deliciously chaotic world of Multiverse Kaitenzushi, a mixed reality experience where you become a sushi chef with a linguistic twist! In this unique language-learning adventure, you’ll grab Japanese letters, assemble them into sushi orders, and serve multiverse-spanning customers!

[media]

Each customer’s order is a fun puzzle made of hiragana and katakana characters. Practice pronunciation, letter recognition, and memory as you race against time to serve the right sushi. 

Whether you're just starting your Japanese journey or want a fresh, exciting way to review, Multiverse Kaitenzushi makes learning unforgettable. Play, move, speak, and interact—because in this multiverse, language is the secret ingredient.

Grab the letters. Assemble the sushi. Serve the multiverse.

Are you ready to become the ultimate multiverse sushi master?
